examples.text: It is illegal to hunt hawks or other raptors in many parts of the world.

glosses: Any diurnal predatory terrestrial bird of similar size and appearance to the accipitrid hawks, such as a falcon.

examples.text: The vendors were hawking their wares from little tables lining either side of the market square.

glosses: A noisy effort to force up phlegm from the throat.
To expectorate, to cough up (something, such as mucus) from one's throat; to produce (something) by coughing or clearing one's throat.

glosses: To try to cough up something from one's throat; to clear the throat loudly; to cough heavily, especially causing uvular frication.

examples.text: Grandpa sat on the front porch, hawking and wheezing, as he packed his pipe with cheap tobacco.
